Perspective Authors 1 Related Companies 1 Share On Tuesday, voters rejected AI data centers almost everywhere they appeared on the ballot. Of 47 local data center measures decided in votes this year, 46 went against development. Anthropic IPO Timeline Endangered | Contrary Research Companies Reports Topics About Subscribe Report / Powered by Discover Companies Reports Topics About Connect Email LinkedIn Twitter Subscribe Powered by © 2026 Contrary Research · All rights reserved | Privacy Policy Report / Perspective Foundation Models Venture & Startup Markets Anthropic IPO Timeline Endangered November 7, 2026 | 2 min A perspective from Contrary Research. Perspective Authors 1 Related Companies 1 Share Anthropic has already delayed its IPO once, and rumors are now swirling that it may cancel the offering altogether. In September, Reuters reported the listing would slip to late October, and the WSJ later reported a November target so the company could show third-quarter results. The company’s October 26 filing set the company up to begin Nasdaq trading under the ticker ANT as soon as November 16. As that date approaches, however, concerns about the viability of the offering are mounting: The amended S-1 filed November 2 reported Q3 revenue of about $17 billion and roughly $895 billion in purchase and lease commitments. That revenue works out to about $68 billion a year, barely above the $65 billion run rate reported in July . Blackstone reportedly expects Anthropic’s debt to carry a junk rating, which would make raising debt to cover compute commitments challenging. Markets have soured on the AI trade
